result.summary: The home screen has several layout overflow and clipping problems: restaurant cards and category chips are cut off, the Orders tab is missing its icon, and the bottom popular card is truncated by the tab bar.

issues.description: The last restaurant in the 'Fastest near you' row (Trattoria Piccol) is clipped at the right edge, cutting off both the image and the restaurant name.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding and peek/overflow so cards can scroll fully into view without clipping text or images.

issues.description: The category filter chips overflow the right edge; 'Healthy' is cut off and the next chip is only a sliver.
issues.suggestion: Make the chip row horizontally scrollable with enough end padding so the last visible chip is not truncated.

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation has a label but no icon, unlike Home, Search, and Profile.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (or hide the tab until the asset is available) so the nav bar is consistent.

issues.description: The second Popular card (pizza with -20%) is cut off by the bottom tab bar, so the restaurant name, rating, and other details are not visible.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset equal to the tab bar height so cards can scroll fully above the navigation.

issues.description: The notification bell badge sits very close to the status-bar battery area and may feel cramped on notched devices.
issues.suggestion: Increase top/right spacing around the header actions so the badge does not collide with system UI.

issues.description: Delivery-time pills on the first-row cards sit over the food images and can obscure the dish illustration.
issues.suggestion: Give the overlay more contrast/padding or place time estimates below the image so artwork stays fully visible.
